terms.title: Terms
terms.s1: ChampStep is a digital service for recording children's achievements, provided by ChampStep LLC (registration no. 7331521).
terms.s2: Register with your email. No card details are required to register. Never share your password with others.
terms.s3: Paid plans are prepaid via QPay (bank app or QR code) and activated for 30 days. There is no automatic renewal and no automatic charge — when the period ends, you renew by paying again yourself. An expired plan reverts to the Free plan and your data is kept. An e-receipt (e-barimt) is issued once payment is confirmed. Prices may change with advance notice; changes do not affect an active subscription period.
terms.s4: Prohibited: entering others' personal data, damaging the system, creating fake accounts, or copyright infringement.
terms.s5: We reserve the right to terminate accounts violating our rules without prior notice. You may delete your own account at any time.
terms.r1: There is no auto-renewal, so nothing needs cancelling — if you do not pay again, the plan simply ends after 30 days. You keep full access until the paid period ends.
terms.r2: Within 7 days of payment, if the paid features have not actually been used (no extra children, PDF export or AI insights), the payment is refunded in full. Send requests to info@champstep.mn.
terms.r3a: The paid features have actually been used
terms.r3b: More than 7 days have passed since payment
terms.r3c: Account terminated due to policy violations
terms.r4: Refunds are returned via QPay (to the account used for payment) within 5 business days of receiving the request.
terms.p1: Your data is controlled by ChampStep LLC (Apt 21, Building 60b, 14th khoroolol, 42nd khoroo, Bayanzurkh district, Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia). Contact: info@champstep.mn.
terms.p2: Email address, name, child's name, achievements, practice logs and photos. Payment data is not stored in our system — it is processed by QPay.
terms.p3: Used only to provide the service, manage subscriptions, and offer technical support. Never sold or transferred to third parties.
terms.p4Title: 4. Who Can See a Child's Data
terms.p4: A child's data and photos are visible only to the parent and to a teacher the parent has invited. Reflection (mood) notes are visible only to the parent — never to teachers.
terms.p5: All data is stored encrypted on Firebase. Sign-in is managed by Firebase Authentication and access is enforced by server-side security rules.
terms.p6: You can delete a child's record (achievements, photos, practice logs, reflections, coach notes, AI insights) and your own account from the app at any time. Deleted data cannot be recovered. Payment records (order id, plan, amount) contain no personal data and are retained for the period required by law.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: ChampStep is an app for parents and teachers to record a child's achievements and practice. This policy applies to the web app (champstep.mn) and the iOS/Android apps alike.
privacy.s1: Account: e-mail, name, role (parent / teacher); with Google or Apple sign-in the name and e-mail they provide. Child data (entered by the parent): name, birth date, avatar photo, achievements (title, date, place, description, photos), practice entries, reflection notes, goals, teacher notes. Technical: push notification token, language, device type. Payments: plan payment records (order id, plan, amount, status). We never store card details — payments are processed by QPay.
privacy.s2: To run the app (records, portfolio PDF, practice statistics), the reminders you opt into (push), plan entitlements and support. No automatic marketing notifications. No advertising to children.
privacy.s3: Google Firebase (authentication, database, file storage, push — US data centres), Vercel (web/API hosting), QPay (payments), Anthropic (AI insight: only achievement titles, categories and dates are sent; never the child's name or photos). We do not sell data.
privacy.s4: Until you delete your account. Payment records are kept as required by financial law. Backups up to 14 days.
privacy.s5: In the app: Account settings → "My data" (JSON/ZIP export), delete a child, delete the whole account (photos, entries and push tokens included). Reminders can be switched off at any time.
privacy.s6: The app is made for parents and teachers (age rating 4+). Child data is entered and managed by the parent only; an invited teacher can view it.
privacy.s7: info@champstep.mn — Champ Step LLC. Changes to this policy are posted here with a new date.
